test_case.test_name: TH.1_Thermal Stress Test — parameterized review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Demonstrate the fully populated SUT, including CPU, GPU, InfiniBand and E1.S devices, sustains the approved worst-case ambient and full-power workload without thermal warning, fault, unsafe throttling or component error.
required_package: Exact SUT population, cooling/power mode and chamber/fixture calibration
Worst-case ambient setpoint/tolerance, ramp, stabilization and soak duration
CPU/GPU/IB/E1.S workload commands plus utilization/power targets
Per-sensor warning/fault/throttle/telemetry limits, hard aborts and cooldown/recovery
test_case.test_command: Bind chamber calibration/orientation and signed ambient ramp/stabilization/soak profile; inventory all loads and sensors; start synchronized CPU/GPU/IB/E1.S workloads to their approved utilization/power targets; continuously record chamber, component, fan/pump/PSU, throttle, OS and SEL telemetry; apply hard aborts; cool down and run the recovery health checklist.
test_case.expected_result: Every required load remains at target for the full formal soak, all temperatures and cooling/power signals remain inside signed limits, no forbidden warning/fault/throttle/error occurs, telemetry is complete, and post-cooldown health matches baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the owner-signed ambient/tolerance/soak/load/threshold package and complete concurrent-run evidence. Missing thresholds, telemetry loss, short smoke duration, phased substitution without approval, workload drop, abort or unexpected warning/fault is FAIL/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Independent chamber/thermal/power monitoring and emergency shutdown
Abort immediately on limit, telemetry loss, cooling/power/component fault or runaway rise
Do not retry at temperature or suppress/clear warnings; controlled cooldown required
expected_evidence: Per-component workload command, mapping, utilization and power attainment
Abort/cooldown/final baseline, no-missing-telemetry report and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Automatically stop loads and chamber heating at any signed abort, preserve synchronized evidence, follow the approved controlled cooldown, verify fans/pumps/PSUs/devices and logs, and do not restart or repeat without engineer authorization.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure and Criteria consistently require full-system worst-case-ambient stress with no thermal warning/fault; missing parameters are engineering inputs.

blocked.reason: A safe review-layer method is defined; missing project values are runtime gates rather than a review blocker.
